import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
)

func readFileFromDir(filename, dirPath string) string {
	filePath := fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s", dirPath, filename)
	cleanedPath := filepath.Clean(filePath)
	content, err := os.ReadFile(cleanedPath)
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	return string(content)
}
```

3. **Rate Limiting**: While not explicitly implemented here due to scope constraints, rate limiting can be added at a higher level to prevent excessive calls to this function.
